record.field: Export asset prices to another system

field.name: documentation
field.p: Allow other systems to fetch asset prices from this system. The ticker must match in both systems.

record.field: prices = self.env['investment.asset.price'].search([('asset_id.ticker', '=', ticker), ('prediction', '=', False)], limit=5, order='time desc') obj = prices.xml_export(['time', 'price'])
Import asset prices from another system

field.name: documentation
field.p: Fetches asset prices from another Odoo instance, and imports them here. The asset ticker is used as the identifier between two systems.
